== Notes ==
* He shares his spawn point in the Abaddon's Mouth mission with [[Cairn the Relentless]], [[Mercia the Smug]], [[Optimus Caliph]], [[Sarlic the Judge]] and [[Willa the Unpleasant]]. One of these bosses will always spawn alongside Cairn the Destroyer.

== Trivia ==
* A [[w:cairn|"cairn"]] is a pile of stones to serve as a monument or to mark a path.
